g.text: Order matters: Σx² squares each value then adds; (Σx)² adds then squares. In Python, x**2 squares; x^2 does NOT.

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #555555

g.text: Logs turn products into sums, and log(a + b) is NOT log a + log b.
